title: Estimating Implicit Expected Log Density Ratios
abstract: arXiv:2610.38151v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When exact probabilities cannot be computed, \emph{density ratio estimation (DRE)} is a key subroutine in the wide range of applications where density ratios appear, from experimental design to generative modelling and reinforcement learning. In this paper, we introduce the concept of an \emph{expected log density ratio (ELDR)}: log density ratios that are integrated under some third, possibly distinct measure. We show many problems with implicit densities where DRE is na\"ively used are actually ELDR estimation tasks, and prove fundamental limitations on finite-sample ELDR estimation. Based on these results, we argue that the typical DRE-based approaches are unsuitable for ELDR estimation, and provide some foundational motivation towards bespoke ELDR estimators. translated_title: 估计隐式期望对数密度比
translated_abstract: 当无法计算精确概率时，密度比估计（DRE）是在密度比广泛出现的应用领域（从实验设计到生成建模和强化学习）中的关键子程序。在本文中，我们引入了期望对数密度比（ELDR）的概念：即在某个第三种（可能不同的）测度下进行积分的对数密度比。我们证明了许多在隐式密度下天真地使用DRE的问题实际上是ELDR估计任务，并证明了有限样本ELDR估计存在根本性的限制。基于这些结果，我们认为典型的基于DRE的方法不适用于ELDR估计，并为定制化的ELDR估计器提供了一些基础性的理论依据。为了进行演示，我们对一些DRE方法提出了一个简单的修改，使得收敛到积分分布的样本能够出现在训练数据中。我们通过……（摘要此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出期望对数密度比（ELDR）这一新概念，揭示了许多天真使用密度比估计（DRE）的问题实为ELDR估计任务，证明了有限样本ELDR估计的根本性限制，并指出基于DRE的典型方法不适用于此任务，从而为定制化ELDR估计器奠定理论基础。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the concept of expected log density ratios (ELDR), shows that many problems naively tackled with density ratio estimation (DRE) are actually ELDR estimation tasks, proves fundamental limitations of finite-sample ELDR estimation, and argues that typical DRE-based approaches are unsuitable, thereby motivating bespoke ELDR estimators.
